mapper.select: SELECT question_id, survey_id, question_text, question_type, order_num FROM TB_SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} ORDER BY order_num ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY_QUESTION ( survey_id, question_text, question_type, order_num ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{questionText}, #{questionType}, #{orderNum} )
mapper.select: SELECT option_id, question_id, option_text, order_num FROM TB_SURVEY_OPTION WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY order_num ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY_RESPONSE ( survey_id, user_id, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{userId}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY_ANSWER ( response_id, question_id, option_id, answer_text ) VALUES ( #{responseId}, #{questionId}, #{optionId}NULL, #{answerText} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.option_id, o.option_text, o.question_id, o.order_num, COUNT(a.answer_id) AS response_count FROM TB_SURVEY_OPTION o LEFT JOIN TB_SURVEY_ANSWER a ON o.option_id = a.option_id LEFT JOIN TB_SURVEY_RESPONSE r ON a.response_id = r.response_id AND r.survey_id = #{surveyId} WHERE o.question_id IN ( SELECT question_id FROM TB_SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} ) GROUP BY o.option_id, o.option_text, o.question_id, o.order_num ORDER BY o.question_id, o.order_num
